# Methods

::: {.callout-note}
**Skeleton.** This chapter will document estimators S1-S6, the first-stage / manipulation check, robustness checks R1-R9, and known threats to validity (analysis plan §6-§9). No estimator code runs here; results chapters consume `results/estimates/`.
:::

## Estimators (planned)

| Spec | Method | Panel | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | Event study (dynamic DiD) | A | Primary for RQ1 |
| S2 | Static TWFE DiD | A | CRZ vs control; border vs control |
| S3 | Cross-city synthetic control | B | Primary for systemwide RQ1 / RQ2 context |
| S4 | Within-NYC synthetic control | A aggregates | Lower bound under H3 spillovers |
| S5 | Synthetic DiD | A aggregates / B | Arkhangelsky et al. (2021) |
| S6 | Bayesian structural time series | Single series | First-stage and secondary outcomes |

## Inference contract

Every estimator returns an `EstimateResult` (`src/cpca/estimators/base.py`) and serializes to `results/estimates/`. Point estimates are always reported with uncertainty intervals; specifications are not dropped for unwelcome signs.
